Name: Shipment Tracker
Author: iceburg
Description:
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/321-0-1460830697.png[/img]

 
Shipment Tracker is a two part mod:
1) Install a Stardew SMAPI mod that tracks what you ship
2) Upload the tracked stats to a [url=https://manapart.github.io/stardew-bin-tracker-site/]website to view and explore the history of what you’ve shipped.[/url]

 [url=https://github.com/ManApart/StardewBinTrackerSite]Source Code for those interested
[/url]and [url=https://github.com/ManApart/shipment-tracker]here[/url]
 
[b][size=3]Install Instructions
[/size][/b]
1) Install SMAPI
Main page: [url=https://github.com/ClxS/SMAPI]https://github.com/ClxS/SMAPI[/url]
Install .net, which you need: [url=https://www.microsoft.com/en-gb/download/details.aspx?id=30653]https://www.microsoft.com/en-gb/download/details.aspx?id=30653[/url]
Install SMAPI: [url=https://github.com/ClxS/SMAPI/releases/tag/0.40.0]https://github.com/ClxS/SMAPI/releases/tag/0.40.0[/url]
Download the SMAPI Zip, and move the contents toyour Stardew Program Folder (something like: C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam
Library\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley
 
2) Install the mod:
Extract the zip to your mods folder:
C:\Users\<user_name>\AppData\Roaming\StardewValley\Mods
So it should look like:
C:\Users\<user_name>\AppData\Roaming\StardewValley\Mods\ShipmentTracker
 
3) Play the game. After you’ve shipped some stuff, you should see a file in the \Mods\Shipment Tracker folder. (Something like your farmer name + Track Stats.csv
You can upload this file to see your stats

4) Upload the tracked stats to a [url=https://manapart.github.io/StardewBinTrackerSite/]website to view and explore the history of what you’ve shipped.[/url]

You can also download and unzip the website if you'd like to use it offline. You should be able to just open the index.html with a browser and have it work exactly like the online site.
